aria: Canary hit OOMs during eager hotstart for a mixed-format bundle. Loader assumed fixed mmap offsets; gz shards break that.

josh: Minimal repro/log?

aria: 2026-03-18T15:02:31Z WARN warmup: hotstart mmap bounds error. Repro: pytest tests/warmup/test_hotstart.py::test_mixed_shard_hotstart --eager-warmup

kai: Root cause: manifest only has {shard_id,size,url,checksum}. Hotstart needs per-shard chunk layout (offsets + compression flags).

maria: Proposal: add optional manifest field `hotstart_layout` with per-shard chunk metadata. Backwards compatible; old clients ignore it.

josh: Alternative: loader performs a small ranged probe per shard to detect format (safetensors header, gzip magic). No manifest change but adds latency and depends on range support.

aria: Measured probe cost: ~0.2ms local, ~10ms S3 per shard. For 64 shards that's significant. Some CDNs also mess with ranged reads.

kai: I vote manifest-first, probe fallback. Manifest = one-time accurate metadata; probe = fallback when manifest missing.

maria: Rollout plan: 1) add optional `hotstart_layout` to manifest schema 2) loader consumes layout when present 3) probe shim behind `EAGER_HOTSTART_PROBE` flag 4) canary + metrics.

ops-bot: Add metrics: warmup_failure_count, warmup_probe_latency_ms_p50_p95, hotstart_success_rate. Alert if warmup_failure_count > 5 in 1h.

aria: Action items: aria -> manifest PR + example bundles; kai -> loader shim prototype + microbench; josh -> tests + S3 sim; ops -> metrics and alerts. I'll open PR and tag eng-ml. :thumbsup:
